# Master in Computer Science

EURECOM teaches a Master's program ("Diplôme National de Master") in Computer Science, fully accredited by the French State (Data Dock and RNCP certifications).

The teaching is done 100% in English. [...] The curriculum is 100% taught in English. Also, French classes will be compulsory during your stay at EURECOM, the obtention of a A2certification being needed to obtain the degree.

 Career Preparation:

Throughout the year, EURECOM helps students to prepare for their future job search by organising thematic workshops (writing a compelling CV/ motivation letter/ interview preparation) and Job/Internship fairs where students get to meet HR recruiters face to face.

### Academic Regulations: [...] Research-oriented students may apply for doctoral studies in France or abroad after completion of the program.

Since 2006, more than 250 students from 40 nationalities have been enrolled in a Master's program at EURECOM, with successful career outcomes after graduation in France and abroad in international companies.

Watch a WEBINAR about EURECOM's teaching programs and environment.

results.title: Top 8 Best Universities for Computer Science in France in 2026 | Study.eu
results.snippet:
France has many English-taught programmes at Bachelor’s, Master’s and Doctoral level. They rank highly for Computer Science on the CSRankings scoreboard - a metrics-based ranking of top computer science institutions around the world.

Here’s an overview of the top 8: [...] Public universities are the most common option. They offer a wide range of IT degrees (Bachelors and Masters), often at low tuition fees. These universities are accessible and focus on both theory and practical skills, with many programmes taught in English. [...] If you’re considering private institutions or business schools, tuition fees can be higher, often ranging between €5,000 and €15,000 per year.

### 📝 Admissions requirements:

In addition to a high level of English, you will need to have the following ready to apply for a Computer Science programme in France:

 a cover letter,
 your CV (include relevant projects and hobbies),
 your grades from your previous education,
 references,
 in some cases, there might be entrance test or an interview.
